# HULLROT: ECLIPSION
Hullrot: Eclipsion is a roleplaying project. Everyone who joins helps build the world and the story that comes out of it, so play your part and take the setting seriously. People who refuse to respect it will not be welcome back.
Taypan, the void where all of this happens, is not a kind or forgiving place, and we shape it together. You will die, and you will lose the things you were carrying. Do not let that get to you, and never drop your mask no matter what is going on around you.
Evil has its place in this world and is often fair game. Blowing the enemy's reactor to cripple their base is a smart and effective move, so make them pay for their carelessness. Keep in mind that when the same trick is repeated over and over the round turns stale for everyone and starts to feel like a deathmatch instead of a story.
Killing another player ends a conflict quickly, but try to make it mean something first. A living hostage is almost always worth more than a corpse.

[color=yellow][bold]Open the Guidebook and go to the Rules section before you play.[/bold][/color] You can open it at any time by pressing [color=cyan][bold]Numpad 0[/bold][/color] or clicking the [bold]Guidebook[/bold] button in the game menu. The Rules section also holds the [bold]Roleplay Rules[/bold], which cover mutiny, round removal and hate speech, so read them in full before you join a round.
